const InlineResultLimit = 8 << 10

const MaxTextMatches = 20

const MaxTextPageBytes = 4 << 10

const SummaryPromptVersion = "alva.context.summary/v1"

func (BudgetAdmission) Name() string

func (DefaultApply) ApplyInjections(ctx context.Context, injections []abi.Injection, prompt *[]string, messages *[]wire.Message) error

func (RulesHooks) Name() string

func (apply DefaultApply) ApplyCompressions(ctx context.Context, actions []abi.CompressAction, messages *[]wire.Message, handle abi.ContextHandle, agentID string) error

func (backend *MemoryReferences) ReadText(ctx context.Context, uri string, offset int64, limit int) (TextPage, error)

func (backend *MemoryReferences) SearchText(ctx context.Context, uri, query string, limit int) ([]TextMatch, error)

func (backend *MemoryReferences) StoreText(ctx context.Context, text string) (wire.Reference, error)

func (chain HooksChain) AfterTurn(ctx context.Context, handle abi.ContextHandle, id string) error

func (chain HooksChain) Bootstrap(ctx context.Context, handle abi.ContextHandle, id string) error

func (chain HooksChain) OnBudgetExceeded(ctx context.Context, handle abi.ContextHandle, id string, snapshot abi.ContextSnapshot) ([]abi.CompressAction, error)

func (chain HooksChain) OnMessage(ctx context.Context, handle abi.ContextHandle, id string, message wire.Message) ([]abi.Injection, error)

func (fn SummarizerFunc) Summarize(ctx context.Context, entries []abi.ContextEntry, hints []string) (string, error)

func (hooks DefaultHooks) OnBudgetExceeded(ctx context.Context, handle abi.ContextHandle, agentID string, snapshot abi.ContextSnapshot) ([]abi.CompressAction, error)

func (hooks RulesHooks) OnBudgetExceeded(_ context.Context, _ abi.ContextHandle, _ string, snapshot abi.ContextSnapshot) ([]abi.CompressAction, error)

func (policy BudgetAdmission) AdmitModel(ctx context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, request abi.ModelRequest) error

func (reader ReferenceReader) Read(ctx context.Context, uri string, offset int64, limit int) (TextPage, error)

type BudgetAdmission struct{ System *abi.ContextSystem }

type CompactionPlan struct {
	Cut    int
	Pinned int
}

type ContextFileLoader interface {
	Load(context.Context, ContextFileRequest) (ContextFileResult, error)
}

type ContextFileRequest struct {
	AgentID, Path string
	Lines         *LineRange
	MaxBytes      int
}

type ContextFileResult struct {
	Path, Text         string
	Source             wire.Reference
	StartLine, EndLine int
	Truncated          bool
}

type DefaultApply struct {
	References   ReferenceBackend
	Externalizer Externalizer

	Summarizer Summarizer
}

type DefaultHooks struct {
	RulesHooks
	DecideBudget func(context.Context, abi.ContextHandle, string, abi.ContextSnapshot) ([]abi.CompressAction, error)
}

type Externalizer interface {
	Externalize(context.Context, string, string) (wire.Reference, error)
}

type HooksChain struct{ Hooks []abi.ContextHooks }

type LineRange struct{ Start, End int }

type MemoryFactsBackend interface {
	Query(context.Context, string, int) ([]abi.MemoryFact, error)
	Store(context.Context, abi.MemoryFact) error
	Delete(context.Context, string) error
}

type MemoryReferences struct {
}

type MessageRewrite struct {
	ID      string
	Message wire.Message
}

type ReferenceBackend interface {
	StoreText(context.Context, string) (wire.Reference, error)
	ReadText(context.Context, string, int64, int) (TextPage, error)
	SearchText(context.Context, string, string, int) ([]TextMatch, error)
}

type ReferenceReader struct{ Backend ReferenceBackend }

type RulesHooks struct{ MaxMessages int }

type Store struct {
}

type StoreServices struct {
	Files        ContextFileLoader
	Memory       MemoryFactsBackend
	References   ReferenceBackend
	Externalizer Externalizer
	MaxFileBytes int
}

type Summarizer interface {
	Summarize(context.Context, []abi.ContextEntry, []string) (string, error)
}

type SummarizerFunc func(context.Context, []abi.ContextEntry, []string) (string, error)

type TextMatch struct {
	URI    string `json:"uri"`
	Text   string `json:"text"`
	Offset int64  `json:"offset"`
}

type TextPage struct {
	URI        string `json:"uri"`
	Text       string `json:"text"`
	Offset     int64  `json:"offset"`
	NextOffset int64  `json:"next_offset"`
	TotalBytes int64  `json:"total_bytes"`
	Truncated  bool   `json:"truncated"`
}
